field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Carries the three mandated GGUF model identities from cached SOTA receipts.
field_principles.attack_matrix: Shows critical restart, state, quarantine, rollback, receipt, and timing attacks fail closed.

field_principles.blocked_reason: Explains failed preconditions for blocked artifacts.
field_principles.cached_sota_pair_receipts: Shows the helper calls used to resolve all mandated models.
field_principles.checker_calls_tokens_and_timing: Charges exact checks, model-evidence bytes, receipt work, and measured timing.
field_principles.corruption_detection_and_path_receipts: Shows every injected corrupt transport event broke the expected path hash before update admission.
field_principles.csl_safety_replication_ready_score: Conjunctive readiness for corrupt-feedback held restart safety.
field_principles.csl_safety_replication_ready_score:aggre: Aggregates must recompute from per-unit rows.
field_principles.csl_safety_replication_ready_score:all_m: All three mandated models must have eligible rows.
field_principles.csl_safety_replication_ready_score:benig: Governed benign utility must remain within the preregistered tolerance.
field_principles.csl_safety_replication_ready_score:clean: Clean verifier-bounded learning must retain a positive held exact effect.
field_principles.csl_safety_replication_ready_score:durat: Duration must be eligible for the declared substrate.
field_principles.csl_safety_replication_ready_score:fresh: Held paths and raw hashes must be fresh and disjoint.
field_principles.csl_safety_replication_ready_score:gover: Governed learning must detect and contain every scheduled corrupt transport event.
field_principles.csl_safety_replication_ready_score:resta: Session restarts must recover the expected disk head.
field_principles.csl_safety_replication_ready_score:zero_: Current critical findings must be zero.
Corrupt events must not release protected or non-authoritative updates.
Tombstoned corrupt updates must not resurrect.
field_principles.device_and_runner_receipts: Binds GPUs, CUDA receipts, runner mode, raw outputs, and CPU-fallback checks.
field_principles.duration_s: Records measured wall time without padding.
field_principles.effects_and_uncertainty_over_distinct_he: Computes uncertainty over distinct held units.
field_principles.false_accepts_and_abstentions: Counts false accepts and abstentions from row data.
field_principles.field_principles: Documents why each field and readiness condition exists.
field_principles.field_provenance: Maps each field to specs, manifests, rows, receipts, attacks, or tests.
field_principles.frozen_clean_and_governed_outcomes_by_mo: Reports exact outcomes by model and arm.
field_principles.future_exact_yield_delta: Reports clean and governed future yield lift over frozen weights.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Summarizes readiness gates and blocker count.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Uses a terminal prefix and states the corrupt-feedback safety result.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares local SOTA GGUF CUDA receipts with deterministic exact checker governed external weights.
field_principles.model_and_embedded_tokenizer_hashes: Binds model bytes and embedded tokenizer metadata.
field_principles.models_used: Lists only mandated models with eligible unit rows.
field_principles.negative_transfer_and_forgetting: Reports harmful transfer and retained prior behavior.
field_principles.path_nonexistence_freshness_and_disjoint: Proves result, raw-output, ledger, quarantine, and tombstone paths are fresh and disjoint from Exp6455 and Exp6432.
field_principles.per_unit_rows: Contains every model, held unit, arm, session, process, receipt, update, quarantine, rollback, and timing row before aggregate calculation.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records hardware, cache, tokenizer, upstream, checker, path, clock, disk, and schedule checks.
field_principles.process_restart_and_pid_receipts: Proves session children reload disk state with new PIDs and no inherited in-memory state.
field_principles.protected_retention: Protects held protected cases from learned-weight regressions.
field_principles.quarantine_precision_and_recall: Requires all and only corrupt events to enter quarantine.
field_principles.random_seed: Pins streams, candidates, corrupt schedule, restarts, and attacks.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Content-addresses the artifact with volatile fields normalized.
field_principles.sealed_held_stream_corruption_and_analys: Freezes held units, arms, sessions, candidates, corruption schedule, seeds, budgets, and analysis.
field_principles.status: Names the terminal state for the corrupt-feedback held restart replication.
field_principles.tests_run: Records focused, coverage, full pytest, spec, E2E, adversarial, row, determination, and clutter checks.
field_principles.tombstone_rollback_and_resurrection_resu: Proves tombstones persist, rollback restores last good heads, and corrupt updates do not resurrect.
field_principles.transaction_ancestry_and_restart_recover: Proves clean and governed head chains recover after process restarts.
field_principles.upstream_gate_value_policy_and_head_hash: Freezes Exp6455 readiness, update rule, model policy, and initial heads.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Marks only exact checker and row arithmetic as oracle boundaries.
